- ACIS (Action-Conditioned Importance Scoring): cross-attention scoring module
- MMR (Margin Maximization Regularization): hinge loss to push Δ_k = s_k - s_{k+1} > δ

- Applied to SmolVLA (450M VLA model) on LIBERO robotics tasks
